subject: Hybrid marketplace listing: sandbox POC, HIPAA dataflow questions & PrivateOffer preflight
messages:

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid marketplace listing: sandbox POC, HIPAA dataflow questions & PrivateOffer preflight

Hi Laura / Vivek —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. A few things from our security and infra side before we lock the sandbox window next week: 

- We need a diagram showing the end-to-end dataflow for the POC (ingest -> inference -> logs) that highlights any egress or shared storage. HIPAA team wants to confirm there is no persistent PHI landing in third-party buckets.
- Can Redwood host the sandbox inside our GCP private VPC via Shared VPC / VPC-SC? If not, we need to scope network flow requirements.
- Private Offer: legal asked whether the Private Offer will include explicit data residency commitments and an auditable log export cadence.

If you can get a short diagram and the checklist by Monday we can confirm the 7/9 sandbox start. Attaching our baseline dataflow template for reference.

Thanks,
Alice
Director, Infrastructure — Acme Health

[attachment: acme-poc-template.xlsx]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: alice.moreno@acmehealth.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid marketplace listing: sandbox POC, HIPAA dataflow questions & PrivateOffer preflight

Alice — thanks, really helpful list. Quick responses and next steps below.

1) Dataflow diagram / PHI controls- Attached: poc-dataflow-diagram.png (annotated). Short summary: Redwood will deploy the inference runtime into a dedicated GCP project for the sandbox. Logs and usage telemetry will be written to a customer-dedicated BigQuery dataset in their project (no shared buckets). By default no raw input is persisted; customers can opt-in to persist transcripts to their BQ dataset. For the POC we will set persistence OFF.

2) Network topology / Shared VPC- We can support two integration modes:
   * PrivateLink-style (recommended): Redwood runs the runtime in our GCP project and exposes an internal load balancer endpoint reachable via VPC peering or Shared VPC peering from Acme. This requires a one-time VPC firewall rule and a peering setup window (~2-3 hours).
   * Customer-hosted runtime: if Acme prefers, we can ship our Private deployment package (container + helm) and run inside their VPC; note this adds ~3-4 days for infra validation for the POC.

3) Private Offer & audit/export cadence- We will include a Private Offer with explicit data residency (US-only) and an exportable audit log (daily exports to a customer-managed GCS/BQ sink). We will attach a HIPAA evidence checklist and a proposed SLA excerpt for the Private Offer preflight.

Next actions that would unblock the 7/9 sandbox start:
- Vivek: confirm which network mode Acme prefers (peering vs. customer-hosted).
- Ben: I need the Private Offer template filled with pricing and term window so legal can draft.
- Alice: review the attached diagram and checklist; flag anything missing by EOD Tue.

I'll attach the HIPAA checklist (hipaa-evidence-checklist.pdf) and the PrivateListing preflight spreadsheet for our legal/finance inputs.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Principal Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

[attachments: poc-dataflow-diagram.png, hipaa-evidence-checklist.pdf, privatelisting-preflight.xlsx]

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: alice.moreno@acmehealth.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 04 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid marketplace listing: sandbox POC, HIPAA dataflow questions & PrivateOffer preflight

Alice / Laura — following up on network mode. A couple technical clarifications from my side: 

- If we go peering (Redwood-hosted runtime + VPC peering), we will provision a private endpoint in us-central1 and advertise a CIDR for the sandbox. Acme will need to add a route and a firewall allowlist for that CIDR. I estimate infra team time of ~3 hours to complete peering and LB setup once we have routing approvals.
- For the customer-hosted runtime option, we should scope the minimum VM + GPU inventory for the POC: 1 x n2-standard + 1 x A10G (or equivalent) with 50GB ephemeral disk should be sufficient for the demo profile. If Acme prefers this we will request access to their pilot project and run a short validation checklist.

Also flagging one marketplace-specific item: to enable co-sell uplift via GCP Private Offer, we need to confirm whether Acme requires reseller billing (partner-of-record) or direct Private Offer billing. Ben — can you confirm the preferred billing flow? That will change how we map SKUs in the Private Offer.

I can be on the 7/9 call to help with the peering runbook if we choose that path.

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: alice.moreno@acmehealth.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 06 Jul 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid marketplace listing: sandbox POC, HIPAA dataflow questions & PrivateOffer preflight

Alice — quick pricing & billing note for Private Offer mapping.

- For the POC we propose a time-limited Private Offer (90 days) at a pre-negotiated usage credit of $12k. We can set billing to direct Private Offer billing (Acme pays GCP directly under the private offer) and have Redwood listed as the co-sell partner to enable uplift. This avoids reseller PO paperwork for the POC while keeping co-sell attribution intact.
- If Acme prefers to route through a reseller later we can reissue a new Private Offer for that cadence.

Action items I completed: uploaded a draft Private Offer spreadsheet into the shared Drive (link below) and filled proposed SKUs and credit table. Laura — please confirm the final term window and I'll route to GCP PM for Private Offer creation.

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-acme-poc (Private Offer draft: priv_offer_acme_2028Q3.xlsx)

Looking forward to locking the sandbox. I recommend the peering flow to keep the POC start tight — less infra ramp time.

Ben Carter
Partner Sales Lead — Redwood Inference
